* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rey (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/rey.gif rey.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit e8445f0 "Fixing case and making gifs", 1 June 2022.</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. When deployed, may take any card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. Your total battle destiny here is +1. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 6 if on Jakku).” '''What changed:''' the words are the same; the card was re-rendered at higher resolution and the margin lost its three uniqueness dots. A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). No errata mark. The card prints the errata mark “none” although this is change 1 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). Before/after: [[File:V4-L-Rey-compare-022435b-e8445f0.png|440px]]
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Rey (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/rey.gif rey.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 9d2c01e "Fixing case and making gifs", 30 December 2024.</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. No errata sheet for this change has been found; the PC card data changed on 13 January 2025. The card prints the errata mark “E1” although this is change 2 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark).
